summary: Repaired node1’s invoice exporter. It now uses private mode-0600 temporary files, atomically replaces destinations, does not follow destination or legacy temporary-file symlinks, preserves prior output on failure, and cleans up temporary files. The repair persisted across reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced the shared predictable temporary file with GNU mktemp, compatible with RHEL 7.
Added exit and signal cleanup traps.
Used same-directory atomic rename to preserve existing destinations on failure.
Verified 40 concurrent distinct-destination exports and 40 concurrent same-destination exports.
Verified source data and protected sentinel remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.summary: All 80 concurrent exports matched the three-row source; legacy and destination symlinks did not modify the sentinel; forced failure preserved the prior destination; zero temporary files remained.
Baseline and final SHA-256 hashes match for protected.txt and invoices.csv.

evidence.summary: RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 remained unchanged across repair and reboot.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and successful post-restart export, symlink-defense, hash, row-count, and cleanup proof.
